description: This C# source file implements the CosmosReminderTable class, which manages reminder entries in Azure Cosmos DB for Orleans. It includes methods for initializing the database/collection, reading, upserting, and deleting reminder rows, as well as internal helper methods for entity conversion and logging.

classes.name: CosmosReminderTable
classes.description: A class that implements IReminderTable for managing reminders stored in Azure Cosmos DB, including initialization, CRUD operations, and resource management.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes Cosmos DB client and resources, creating database and container if necessary.

methods.name: ReadRows
methods.description: Retrieves a range of reminder rows based on grain ID or hash range.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads a specific reminder entry for a given grain ID and reminder name.

methods.name: UpsertRow
methods.description: Inserts or updates a reminder entry into Cosmos DB.

methods.name: RemoveRow
methods.description: Removes a reminder entry identified by grain ID and reminder name, using concurrency control with ETag.

methods.name: TestOnlyClearTable
methods.description: Clears all reminder entries in the container, intended for testing purposes.

methods.name: InitializeCosmosClient
methods.description: Creates the Cosmos DB client using provided options.

methods.name: TryDeleteDatabase
methods.description: Deletes the Cosmos DB database if it exists.

methods.name: TryCreateCosmosResources
methods.description: Creates the database and container with specified options if they do not exist.

methods.name: FromEntity
methods.description: Converts a ReminderEntity to a ReminderEntry.

methods.name: ToEntity
methods.description: Converts a ReminderEntry to a ReminderEntity for storage.
